with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive_bytes), mode="r:gz") as source_archive:
    for member in source_archive.getmembers():
        member_path = PurePosixPath(member.name)
        if (
            member_path.is_absolute()
            or ".." in member_path.parts
            or not member.isfile()
            or len(member_path.parts) < 2
            or member_path.parts[0] != "public-core"
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(f"unsafe or unexpected archive member: {member.name}")
        relative = PurePosixPath(*member_path.parts[1:]).as_posix()
        if relative not in expected_files or relative in seen_files:
            raise RuntimeError(f"unlisted or duplicate archive member: {relative}")
        payload = source_archive.extractfile(member)
        if payload is None:
            raise RuntimeError(f"cannot read archive member: {relative}")
        data = payload.read()
        expected = expected_files[relative]
        if len(data) != expected["bytes"]:
            raise RuntimeError(f"size mismatch: {relative}")
        if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != expected["sha256"]:
            raise RuntimeError(f"hash mismatch: {relative}")
        destination = SOURCE_PARENT.joinpath(*member_path.parts)
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        destination.write_bytes(data)
        seen_files.add(relative)

if seen_files != set(expected_files):
    missing = sorted(set(expected_files) - seen_files)
    raise RuntimeError(f"archive is missing manifest files: {missing}")

sys.path.insert(0, str(SOURCE_ROOT / "src"))
print(f"Verified and extracted {len(seen_files)} tracked files.")
